subject: IAM evidence request — SSO/SAML & SCIM
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Mendes <claire@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Boyle <tom.boyle@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: IAM evidence request — SSO/SAML & SCIM

Hi Claire — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and next steps on the IAM items we discussed for ClearSky Health so your security team can close the questionnaire: 

1) SSO (SAML)
   - Can you share your IdP SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URLs, cert) and a screenshot of the app configuration?
2) SCIM provisioning
   - We support SCIM v2 — please send the SCIM base URL and a service account we can use to test provisioning (or a temporary token).
3) RBAC / Admin controls
   - A short list of admin role names and the privileges (create users, assign roles, deactivate) is sufficient.
4) SOC 2 status / evidence
   - Attaching our SOC 2 summary for reference. If you have an internal SOC 2 report or vendor checklist items, please share.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (Redwood SOC 2 summary)

Next steps: If you can drop the SAML metadata and SCIM details into the HubSpot questionnaire link below, we’ll turn around the vendor questionnaire responses and provide screenshots for audit evidence. I’ll coordinate with our engineering team for a short test window for SCIM provisioning.

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute sync tomorrow to confirm tokens and test scope — do you prefer 10:30am or 2pm PT?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Claire Mendes <claire@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request — SSO/SAML & SCIM

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Attached are the items we have ready: the IdP metadata export and our SCIM config. 

Attachments: clearsky_saml_metadata.xml, clearsky_scim_config.json, vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx

We can’t share our full SOC 2 report externally, but I can provide the sections relevant to IAM controls if needed (redacted). For the SCIM account, please use the service account: scim-test@clearskyhealth.com — I’ll DM you the temporary token via the portal (security policy).

I’ve added Tom on the thread; he’ll help coordinate with IT for screenshots. 2pm PT tomorrow works for us.

—Claire
Claire Mendes
Head of InfoSec | ClearSky Health
claire@clearskyhealth.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: IAM evidence request — next internal steps

Looping in product/engineering owners to scope the SCIM test and the RBAC evidence we need to capture.

Action items for Dev: 
- Confirm SCIM v2 endpoints and expected attribute mappings for provision/create/update/deactivate flows.
- Prepare a short runbook for the test (commands, sample payloads, any rate limits to be aware of).
- Confirm token rotation window — Claire mentioned a temporary token; confirm how we’ll accept it and store it in our test environment.

Action items for Marissa: 
- I’ll draft the questionnaire answers for the security team based on the SAML metadata and our SOC 2 summary. I’ll share a draft for your review before we send it to Claire.

Thanks — planning to block 1 hour after the 2pm sync to run the provisioning test if everything looks good.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Principal Product Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Mendes <claire@clearskyhealth.com>, Tom Boyle <tom.boyle@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request — SSO/SAML & SCIM

Thanks Claire — received the metadata and SCIM file, and appreciate the questionnaire attachment. We’ll: 

- Import the SAML metadata into our test IdP sandbox and validate ACS/EntityID against your endpoints.
- Run a SCIM provisioning smoke test during the 2pm PT sync (we’ll only perform a create then a deactivate for test users).
- Draft the vendor questionnaire answers and include screenshots / exported logs as evidence where applicable.

I attached our SOC 2 summary again for reference and a short checklist of the pieces we’ll provide back (screenshots, config snippets, API call logs). If anything else is needed for procurement, let me know and I’ll escalate.

Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/redwood-clearsky-iam
HubSpot questionnaire: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/HS-98765

Best,
Marissa

Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
